description.value: Salmon Arm Arts Centre, operated by the Shuswap District Arts Council since 1970, is a downtown cultural hub housing the Salmon Arm Art Gallery, artist studios, and a 149-seat theatre. It runs a rich slate of programs including Theatre on the Edge, Wednesday on the Wharf, and the Salmon Arm Pride Project, making it a vibrant stop for travellers passing through the Shuswap. The centre sits in the heart of downtown, easily accessible and well-regarded as a community arts anchor in the BC interior.
